build_resnet50_model: build a ResNet-50 model with optional ImageNet pretrained weights using the resnet50 factory function
build_resnext50_model: build a ResNeXt-50 32x4d model with optional ImageNet pretrained weights using the resnext50_32x4d factory
run_resnet_mine_forward: run a ResNet_mine forward pass to get both classifier output and pre-pooling feature tensors
run_pnorm_normalization: run power normalization on a weight tensor by dividing each row by its L2 norm raised to power p
review_resnet_mine_classifier_toggle: review the ResNet_mine classifier_run flag that controls whether the final fc layer is applied
